metadata.label: MODEL + SATELLITE
metadata.note: MODEL + SATELLITE: a street is blocked from the time the modelled fire reaches it or a satellite sees fire on it (VIIRS 375 m pixel, Sentinel-2 flame front or burned area, or MODIS/SLSTR 1 km pixels in two separate overpasses). A single MODIS/SLSTR detection only raises a 'fire nearby' warning. Not a road survey.
